bignews.title: Jollywood Nights 2026 launched at Hollywood Studios
bignews.body: The ticketed holiday event debuted last night with returning entertainment including Jingle Bell Jingle BAM fireworks and the Glisten ice skating show, now featuring Donald, Daisy, and Genie. New this year: a Checkin It Twice lounge in Animation Courtyard with specialty drinks and a live DJ. Guests leaving the park receive a free photo-frame ornament as an exit gift.

parkioInsight.text: Jollywood party nights tend to pull regular daytime guests out early. If you're not attending, Hollywood Studios usually empties by 5pm on event dates, creating short waits for Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in the hour before close.

bignews.title: Typhoon Lagoon reopens December with new seasonal pass
bignews.body: The water park returns this winter following its annual closure. Disney also brought back the Water Park Seasonal Pass, allowing unlimited visits to both Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach through spring 2027. Blizzard Beach will close in early 2027 for its own refurbishment cycle.

parkioInsight.text: December water park visits often see lighter crowds than summer. Early-week mornings in the first two weeks post-opening typically offer the shortest lines for Crush 'n' Gusher and Miss Adventure Falls.

bignews.title: Wilderness Lodge begins pool and room refurbs through 2028
bignews.body: The deluxe resort added new construction timelines covering pool upgrades and hotel room renovations, extending work into 2028. The project joins ongoing exterior maintenance already in progress at the property.

parkioInsight.text: Multi-year construction at Wilderness Lodge may mean daytime noise near guest rooms and limited pool access. If you've already booked, ask the front desk for a room assignment away from active work zones when you check in.

bignews.title: Grand Floridian Cafe reopened with new breakfast and lunch menu
bignews.body: The table-service restaurant is back after a closure, featuring revised offerings for morning and midday service. The location sits on the first floor of the Grand Floridian Resort near the main lobby.

parkioInsight.text: Newly reopened restaurants often have easier same-day reservations in the first week. Check the My Disney Experience app this morning for lunch slots; walk-up availability may also improve as word spreads slowly.

topstories.title: Character meet lineups expanded for Jollywood Nights
topstories.body: The after-hours event features holiday-costumed characters across the park, including Life Day Chewbacca in Galaxy's Edge and festive versions of classic Disney friends. Meet-and-greet locations are spread throughout Hollywood Studios during party hours.

parkioInsight.text: Character lines at hard-ticket events tend to be shorter than regular park hours, especially in the first and last hour of the party. Prioritize rarer meets like Life Day Chewbacca early; classic characters usually remain available all night.

topstories.title: Rock 'n' Roller Coaster adds holiday overlay signage
topstories.body: The giant guitar outside the attraction now displays a black banner reading 'Obligatory Holiday Overlay' in sticker-style graphics, marking the coaster's seasonal participation without changing the ride experience inside.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal photo ops like the updated guitar create quick Instagram stops. Snap your picture before 10am when the courtyard is less crowded and lighting is better for outdoor shots.

topstories.title: Discovery River Amphitheater south section closed at Animal Kingdom
topstories.body: A portion of the amphitheater area near the water has shut down, joining the resort's growing list of closures and refurbishments that now stretch into 2028. The rest of the park remains accessible.

parkioInsight.text: The amphitheater closure eliminates a shaded rest area popular in the afternoon. Plan your Animal Kingdom midday break in Pandora's shaded queue areas or head to Flame Tree Barbecue's covered seating instead.

topstories.title: Oga's Cantina reservation process changed for all guests
topstories.body: The Star Wars bar in Galaxy's Edge has updated its booking system, making the previously exclusive reservation process more accessible. Walk-up availability remains limited during peak hours.

parkioInsight.text: Oga's walk-up list tends to clear out between 2–4pm on weekdays when many guests are at lunch elsewhere. Join the list during that window for the shortest wait, often under 30 minutes.

topstories.title: Limited-edition holiday pins available with Disney gift card purchase
topstories.body: Walt Disney World and Disneyland are offering free collectible holiday pins with select gift card purchases during the Christmas season. The pins are available while supplies last at resort locations and select retailers.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition pin giveaways typically run out within the first week at high-traffic shops. Stop by Guest Relations or the Emporium early in your trip to claim yours before stock depletes.

topstories.title: Lakeshore Lodge pre-opening DVC preview stays announced
topstories.body: Disney Vacation Club members can now book exclusive First Wave preview nights at the new resort before its official opening. The multi-night packages include early access to amenities and dining.

parkioInsight.text: Soft-opening resort stays often mean limited dining hours and incomplete amenities. If you book a preview stay, confirm restaurant schedules and transportation options directly with Member Services before arrival to avoid surprises.

topstories.title: Disney Springs debuts new holiday treats and Gideon's cookies
topstories.body: The shopping and dining district rolled out seasonal snacks and merchandise, including fresh offerings from Gideon's Bakehouse. Holiday decor is now up throughout the complex.

parkioInsight.text: Gideon's Bakehouse virtual queue fills quickly on weekends. Join the queue via the shop's website right at park opening for the best shot at a same-day slot, usually before 9:30am.

icymi.title: World of Frozen updates theming at Disneyland Paris
icymi.body: The land at Disney Adventure World added new decorative elements less than a year after opening in March. The updates refine guest-facing details in the Arendelle-themed area.

icymi.title: Virtual queues return for select experiences over the holidays
icymi.body: Disney confirmed it will reinstate virtual queue systems for certain attractions during the busy Thanksgiving and Christmas periods. Specific rides and dates have not yet been detailed.

icymi.title: Cinderella Castle Suite giveaway open for 2027 stays
icymi.body: Give Kids the World is running a sweepstakes offering a night in the exclusive Magic Kingdom suite next year. The package includes additional vacation perks and supports the nonprofit's mission.

icymi.title: New Animal Kingdom churro creations combine DOLE Whip flavors
icymi.body: The park introduced two churro offerings that blend the classic fried dough with DOLE Whip soft-serve, created during an internal culinary competition dubbed the Churro-lympics.

spotlight.title: Jollywood Nights exclusive snacks and merchandise now available
spotlight.body: The ticketed event features food items and souvenirs only available during party hours, including specialty beverages at the new Checkin It Twice lounge and limited-edition apparel. All items are sold exclusively to event ticket holders inside Hollywood Studios after regular park close.

parkioInsight.text: Event-exclusive merchandise tends to sell out faster than food. If you're attending tonight or a future party, shop the merch carts in the first 90 minutes; popular items like pins and mugs often disappear by 10pm on busy nights.
